*crosses arms and glares at screen*

I ain't gettin' on no plane, and I ain't lettin' this code get on main neither! This code is JUNK, fool! Let me break it down for you:

## Critical Issues

**SQL Injection Everywhere** - Lines 95, 103, 118, 147, 182, 189, 199
You concatenatin' user input straight into SQL queries! Any fool can drop your whole database with `'; DROP TABLE orders;--`. I pity the fool who thinks string formatting is parameterized queries!

**Storing Credit Cards in Plain Text** - Lines 77, 199
You storing full credit card numbers in the database AND returning them in JSON responses! That's PCI violation, fool! You gonna get fined into oblivion.

## High Severity

**No Error Handling on HTTP Calls** - Lines 48, 55, 59, 69
You ignorin' errors everywhere with `resp, _ :=`. Payment fails? You don't know. Inventory fails? Don't care. This thing gonna process bad orders all day!

**Race Condition in Cache** - Lines 83, 93, 136
You lock the mutex when? NEVER! Multiple goroutines writing to that cache gonna corrupt your data, fool!

**Goroutine Variable Capture Bug** - Lines 127-131
You capturing loop variables `productID` and `quantity` in goroutines but they ain't passed as parameters like you did on line 62. Every goroutine gonna use the LAST values!

## Medium Severity

**No Response Body Close** - Lines 55, 59, 167
You leaking connections everywhere! Close them response bodies or your service gonna choke!

**Payment Before Database** - Lines 55-77
You charge the card THEN try to save the order. Database fails? Customer charged but no order. That's money problems, fool!

**Inventory Reserved in Fire-and-Forget Goroutines** - Lines 62-68
You don't wait for inventory to actually reserve. Order completes, inventory might fail, you got overselling!

**No Input Validation** - Line 41
You trust everything the client sends. Negative prices? Negative quantities? This code accepts it all!

**Float for Money** - Throughout
Using float64 for currency gonna give you rounding errors. Use integers (cents) or decimal type!

## Low Severity

**Unbounded Cache** - Line 83
Cache grows forever. Memory leak waiting to happen!

**Magic Limit** - Line 143
Default limit of 100 with no max. Someone passes limit=1000000, you're dead.

**CSV Injection** - Line 207
Reason field can contain formulas that Excel will execute. `=cmd|' /C calc'!A0`

## The Fix

Use parameterized queries EVERYWHERE. Remove credit card storage. Add proper error handling. Use mutex properly. Pass loop variables to goroutines. Use transactions for payment+database. Validate ALL input.

You tell that developer "works in staging" don't mean NOTHING when attackers hit production! I ain't approving this garbage until it's built RIGHT!
